LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 6.3.1 PAST CONTINUOUS TENSE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Language use 6.3.1 Past Continuous Tense
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 6.3.1 Past Continuous Tense, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: What were the learners doing in school yesterday?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 6.3.1 Past Continuous Tense together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: Listening and Observing skills as the learner listens to and observe signed texts and picks out verbs in past

continuous tense.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation as learners work collaboratively with peers to play language games that involve changing verbs from simple continuous to past

continuous tense.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Life skill: Effective communication as learner uses past continuous tense.

● Health issues in Education: Nutrition as the learners learn about the garden.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to relate the knowledge of past continuous tenses to their learning in other learning areas such as Environmental Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Chart, class readers, course books, flash cards, recording devices e.g tablets, mobile phone, dictionary, internet, signed audio-visual recordings
